title.narrative: In 2024, UNICEF Bangladesh provided humanitarian support to up to 3 million people (95% of the target) including 48% children, 50% females and 2.6% persons with disabilities through an investment of US$120.9 million multi-sectoral emergency response. UNICEF also improved its organizational preparedness for earthquakes, floods, cyclones, and pandemics, achieving an EPP (Emergency Preparedness Platform) preparedness score of 100 per cent.
